message: I want a feedback loop where once per day an agent runs and tries to improve how many notes files get added per day. I think we need to start tracking notes files. Create a Notes Files stock.
text:
The Notes Files stock is already declared, and the instrument is recording it: the latest reading is 24 notes files, one per minute, still a draft until you keep it. I have not changed anything this turn.

The daily loop is still not set up, because the tool that writes standing instructions is not available to me in this session. The three things I need from you are in my earlier reply: whether to keep the instrument, what the daily agent may change, and how success is measured.
